design_philosophy.name: The Tactical Command Center
design_philosophy.description: A high-density, dark-mode-first interface designed for professional social media managers. It combines the precision of a financial terminal with the creative spark of AI tools. It prioritizes data clarity, speed, and 'tactical minimalism'.

dashboard_grid.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6 auto-rows-[minmax(180px,auto)]
rules: Use h-full on children to ensure they stretch.
Primary Data charts should span 2-3 columns.

cards.classes: bg-zinc-900/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/5 shadow-sm rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:border-white/10 transition-colors duration-200

buttons.primary: bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-700 text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(124,58,237,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(124,58,237,0.5)] transition-all duration-300 rounded-lg font-medium px-6 py-2.5
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-white border border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-200 rounded-lg font-medium px-6 py-2.5
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-white/5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors rounded-lg px-4 py-2

inputs.classes: bg-zinc-950/50 border-white/10 focus:border-violet-500/50 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500/20 rounded-lg py-2.5 text-sm transition-all

glassmorphism.use_for: Sticky Headers, Floating Navs, Modal Overlays

images.description: Abstract white wavy lines on a soft background for subtle texture.
Abstract neon lines for AI content generation section.
Man working late at desk, suitable for 'About' or 'Team' section.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors must be used independently, avoiding gradients for backgrounds.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings; use 'Manrope' or 'Barlow Condensed'.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs (p-6, p-8).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
Do NOT use purple or teal for CTAs (use Violet/Indigo or White/Black).
Avoid the Center-Everything Disease; use asymmetry and grids.
BANNED: Generic AI emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, etc.). Use abstract shapes or Lucide icons instead.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards (4.5:1 min).
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings with high contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Shadcn/UI with the 'zinc' neutral color and 'violet' primary color.
3. Implement the Dashboard using the 'Bento Grid' layout defined above.
4. Create a layout wrapper that includes the Sidebar (fixed left) and Topbar.
5. Use the provided image URLs for the Landing Page hero and AI sections.
6. Ensure all charts in the dashboard use the application color palette (Violet, Cyan, Pink, Orange).
